regime_context: The US thematic detector ranks Memory, HBM & Storage as the top theme but with fading momentum, low durability (0.48), zero breadth, and a mixed Hurst tag. Financials is a strong challenger with high durability and broad participation, yet the rotation margin remains wide and rotation directional is false—no confirmed handoff. Crowding is elevated in many trending themes, which serves only as a sizing caution. The absolute-trend gate is the sole validated edge (drawdown/volatility reduction), making eligibility the core risk-control lens. Past call accuracy is 40% with very low direction precision, so any lean demands humility.

theses.subject: AI Agents & Applications
theses.thesis: The only validated edge in thematic allocation is drawdown & shake-out avoidance through the absolute-trend gate. AI Agents & Applications is not trend-eligible (durability_bar 0.36, eligible false), ranks 37th with a negative score, and shows no breadth of participation. Avoiding ineligible themes directly applies that edge—staying out reduces the likelihood of being caught in a vulnerable theme.
theses.dissent: A sudden macro shift or AI-related news could trigger a sharp mean-reversion bounce, but trend-gate discipline would still have avoided the prior drawdown; the gate does not capture such idiosyncratic spikes and staying out is a risk-control decision, not a return forecast.

falsifier.text: If AI Agents & Applications becomes trend-eligible (eligible flips to true) or its momentum score turns significantly positive (e.g., rises into the positive zone and durability improves), the avoid lean would be invalidated.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
